files.caption: Two photographs of 605 Stanley Street, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 605 Stanley Street reads: This home has a living room extending across the entire front of house, with fireplace, dining room, kitchen and rear porch; on the second floor there are 4 bedrooms and bath. This property is covered with slate roof and can be purchased at an attractive price.
